marketing-hero.rationale: Conversion clarity depends first on hero reading path and CTA dominance.

saas-dashboard.rationale: Operational dashboard usefulness depends on density control and metric priority.

dense-admin-panel.rationale: Task completion risk comes from cognitive load and weak grouping.

onboarding-form.rationale: Completion confidence and validation visibility should lead.

pricing-page.rationale: Comparison hierarchy and component consistency drive usefulness.

mobile-app-mockup.rationale: Mobile review should prioritise target confidence and constrained viewport clarity.

zeplin-artboard.rationale: The isolated artboard should be reviewed for hierarchy and polish while editor UI is ignored.

figma-frame.rationale: The frame benchmark is mainly about repeated component treatment drift.

typography-editorial.rationale: Readability and editorial hierarchy are the core concern.

cluttered-anti-pattern.rationale: Visual maturity and composition are the release-quality risk.

accessibility-visible-failure.rationale: Visible readability, status communication, and target clarity should dominate.

inconsistent-design-system.rationale: Repeated component drift is the root issue.
